headline: Approved January 28, 2026 minutes while delaying vote on commercial marina rates until March
summary: The Harbor Management Authority reviewed financial reports, harbormaster updates, facility work, and electrical monitoring issues. Members discussed commercial contract rates, Innoventure Labs plans, kayak racks, an e-engine charging center, and rules for a Mission Boathouse event involving liquor on public property. The board approved the January 28, 2026 minutes and postponed approval of the September 10 and November 19, 2025 minutes.
decisions: Approved the January 28, 2026 minutes, 6-0, with Freeman abstaining.
Postponed approval of the September 10, 2025 and November 19, 2025 minutes until enough members who attended those meetings are present.
